title: RoutingOutcomeV1
description: Cross-org routed-order outcome mirror (leg B). Hub → client deployment on the LODH-owned, org-suffixed topic mmx.routed-order-outcome.{orgCode}. Discriminated by outcomeType. Correlation key (originatingLegalEntityCode, routingId) — no deployment-internal order UUID crosses the boundary. Canonical schema for AsyncAPI and Schema Registry.

outcomeType.description: Type discriminator. ACCEPTED is non-terminal (emitted same-tx as hub-side order creation). EXECUTED/CANCELLED/REJECTED are terminal hub-side transitions.

originatingLegalEntityCode.description: Client TradingClient LegalEntityCode; half of the cross-boundary correlation key.

routingId.description: CGED-minted deterministic routing id; half of the cross-boundary correlation key.

occurredAt.description: When the outcome occurred at the hub.

acceptedAt.description: Present when outcomeType = ACCEPTED. The hub-side accept instant; emitted same-tx as hub-side order creation so the accept signal is exactly as durable as the hub-side order.

institutionCode.description: Present when outcomeType = EXECUTED. Hub-native institution code; the client renders the display counterparty client-side.

contractNumber.description: Present when outcomeType = EXECUTED. Hub-generated contract number.

reason.description: Present when outcomeType = REJECTED. Trader reject reason. Routing-failure rejects (grant/currency/tenor invalid at accept) NEVER ride this channel — they are HTTP-only.
